title: What's New in v2.9.71
notes: 🔥 Direct Firebase & Google Sheets Furnace Sync: Changing furnace levels via the Admin Roster Menu, Account Hub Profile, or Alt Manager now immediately persists across Google Sheets ('Chief's List'), Firebase /roster_live, /users, and /sheets data stores.
🛡️ Alt Account Support: Admins and members can now edit alt account furnace levels and start dates seamlessly with live persistence to linked alt datasets.
⚡ Non-Destructive Background Sync: Resolved issue where background sheets sync cleared manually entered furnace levels for accounts without Century Games verification tokens.

v2.9.65: Upgraded Bug/Feedback resolution note editor to a spacious multi-line textarea with quick templates and pre-wrap formatting
